basic_details.job_title: IIT Hyderabad Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad has invited applications from Indian nationals for one Research Associate-I post in a DBT funded project on genetic variants and drug targets for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS). The remuneration is INR 58,000/- + 27% HRA for a purely temporary appointment of 11 months. The required qualification is a PhD (awarded or thesis submitted) in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Mathematics or Statistics. Candidates apply through a Google form by 4 December 2026.

Complete the form fully and submit it by 4 December 2026. Incomplete applications will not be evaluated.
Send any query to Dr. Rahul Kumar at [email protected].
The notice does not name any documents to attach.
important_instructions: Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for an interview. The PI reserves the right to leave the position vacant if no suitable candidate is found. Incomplete applications will not be evaluated.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Hyderabad Research Associate-I
content_sections.text: The post sits in a project funded by DBT. The project studies novel genetic variants and drug targets for ALS in the Indian population using GenomeIndia data. The notice names Dr. Rahul Kumar as the contact for queries and refers to the "PI" for the selection decision.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. The notice asks for applicants with excellent academic and research backgrounds. Essential qualification: PhD (awarded or thesis submitted) in Bioinformatics/Computational Biology/Computer Science/Mathematics/Statistics. Age: not more than 35 years as on the last day of application. Relaxations for SC/ST/OBC are as per standard government norms. The notice says candidates with prior experience in the following areas will be given preference: Experience in analyzing high volume of multi-omics data Experience in developing AI/ML algorithms for analyzing multi-omics data Experience in handling clinical records/EHR data Development of bioinformatics tools/databases/web-applications Candidates should check the official notification for any further discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is INR 58,000/- + 27% HRA. The appointment is purely temporary and lasts 11 months, starting as soon as possible.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Hyderabad Research Associate-I
content_sections.text: Check that you are an Indian national and meet the qualification and age criteria above. Open the Google form at https://forms.gle/hBvbcBgbjFtkSRjS6 . Complete the form fully and submit it by 4 December 2026. Incomplete applications will not be evaluated. Send any query to Dr. Rahul Kumar at [email protected] . The notice does not name any documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for the interview based on their academic records and relevant work experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified by email about the online interview date. The notice does not give the interview date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for an interview. The PI reserves the right to leave the position vacant if no suitable candidate is found. Incomplete applications will not be evaluated.
